description: The spoofing guard (S-10, U-02): a broadcast claiming one of our fleet's serials, judged against that aircraft's authenticated telemetry. verdict: stranger (not ours), withhold (ours, live, agreeing: the authenticated track is better), as_ours (ours, link quiet: the broadcast speaks for it, still marked broadcast), conflict (ours, live, more than spoof_distance_m away: a separate unverified track, unknown_operator, mismatch, reason serial_conflict). relay_rows are what the bus delivered, in order.

units.apart_m: metres, haversine on a 6,371,008.8 m sphere

generated: Expected values computed by knowledge/tools/gen_vectors.py, which runs the old Python implementation (rootxkit/utm @ 484cd228035f) on these inputs. Regenerate rather than edit.

cases.name: stranger
cases.why: Not one of our serials: nothing to judge.

cases.name: relay-live-and-agreeing-withhold
cases.why: Our relay is live and the broadcast is 50 m from it: the relay track is better; the broadcast is stored, not published.

cases.name: relay-live-far-away-conflict
cases.why: 500 m from where the authenticated relay places our aircraft: not our aircraft (S-10). A separate unverified track, serial_conflict.

cases.name: relay-quiet-broadcast-speaks-for-ours
cases.why: Relay silent for more than 5 s: the broadcast takes over as our aircraft, still marked as a broadcast (P1-15). Nothing can contradict it.

cases.name: relay-live-exactly-at-live-for
cases.why: Heard exactly 5 s ago is still live (<=).

cases.name: relay-live-no-position-withhold
cases.why: Live relay without a position yet: withheld, never judged a conflict without a distance.

cases.name: relay-backlog-is-history
cases.why: U-02 review: a relay draining its queue after an outage delivers minutes-old positions. A backlog row neither makes the link live nor moves the position; without this our own current broadcast was split off as a spoof (SITL re-check 2026-10-01, 438 m apart).

cases.name: relay-row-captured-long-before-receipt-is-history
cases.why: A row captured more than live_for_s before the Gateway received it is history too, even if not flagged backlog.

cases.name: relay-row-slightly-behind-is-live
cases.why: 4 s behind receipt is within live_for_s: live, and 440 m is a conflict.

cases.name: remote-id-rows-do-not-make-the-link-live
cases.why: Only relay telemetry counts; a broadcast (source remote_id or network_remote_id) never vouches for itself.
